Senior Projektentwickler Wohnungsbau (m/w/d)

Standort: Berlin | Vollzeit | Unbefristet

Für unseren Mandanten, ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit Projektentwicklung und Bauorganisation unter einem Dach und anspruchsvollen Wohnungsbauprojekten im Berliner Raum, suchen wir im exklusiven Auftrag zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Senior Projektentwickler (m/w/d). Projekte werden von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung im eigenen Haus realisiert. Sie erwartet eine Position mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Unternehmensentwicklung und der Geschäftsführung.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Akquise: Identifikation und Bewertung von Grundstücken und Projekten (On- und Off-Market) im Berliner Raum

  • Vorprüfung: Prüfung von Projektpotenzialen hinsichtlich Baurecht, Flächen, Risiken und Chancen

  • Ankaufskalkulation: Erstellung von Ankaufskalkulationen inklusive Residualwertberechnungen

  • Transaktionen: Unterstützung bei Strukturierung und Durchführung von Transaktionen (LOI, Due Diligence, Kaufvertrag)

  • Netzwerk: Aufbau und Pflege eines aktiven Netzwerks zu Maklern, Eigentümern, Kommunen und Marktpartnern

data.title: Health and Safety Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Health & Safety Engineer to support safe operations across our facilities, construction activities, manufacturing, testing, and launch operations.

This is a technical role focused on identifying hazards, developing effective controls, and helping teams work safely in a fast-moving engineering environment. You will work closely with operations, engineering, construction, manufacturing, test, and external contractors to ensure that safety is built into the way we work.

Fluent German and experience working with German authorities would be a substantial advantage

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct risk assessments, hazard reviews, workplace inspections, and safety assessments across company operations.

  • Develop practical safety procedures, engineering controls, permits, emergency plans, and supporting documentation.

  • Support safe working practices across construction, manufacturing, testing, hazardous-materials handling, and launch activities.

data.title: Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements across DACH, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.
